Accept an encrypted JWT

Source: R/jwe.R
jwe_decryption.Rd

jwe_decryption() bundles the key and algorithms that jwt_decode() uses to decrypt a JWT sent as a JWE. Without it, a JWE is refused where a JWT is expected, which keeps a signed-token check from silently accepting encrypted tokens (jwcrypto's CVE-2022-3102).

Usage

jwe_decryption(key, algorithms, encryptions)

Arguments

key

A jwk, a jwk_set, or a function of the header returning one.

algorithms

The key management algorithms to accept, such as "A256KW".

encryptions

The content encryption algorithms to accept, such as "A256CBC-HS512".

Value

A jwe_decryption.

Examples

jwe_decryption(jwk_oct(as.raw(1:16)), "A128KW", "A128CBC-HS256")
#> <jwe_decryption> A128KW with A128CBC-HS256
